name: Lalitpur

queries.query: site:upbhulekh.gov.in Lalitpur Uttar Pradesh BhuNaksha official parcel map
queries.result: First-party discovery identified Uttar Pradesh Bhulekh, the official computerized land-record service, the official BhuNaksha cadastral viewer, the Lalitpur district Revenue page, and the official cadastral-map digitization dashboard. The dashboard reports Lalitpur district with 754 revenue villages, 736 verified/linked/georeferenced villages and 1,582 verified/linked/georeferenced mapsheets. No safe anonymous parcel ID-plus-geometry response was obtained.
